unsupported_firmware.title: Unsupported heat pump firmware
unsupported_firmware.description:
{title} runs Genesis firmware {version}, but this integration is written for firmware 17.1. It reads the pump as if it were 17.1, so some values may be wrong or missing.

Please open an issue in the thermia-genesis repository with the diagnostics of this entry, so support for this firmware can be added.
